---
title: "Practical work 2"
subtitle: "DAI · A network application with TCP or UDP"
---

## Objectives

- A **network application**, in a group: an application protocol you
  define, a **server** and a **client** in Java, over TCP, UDP, or
  both.
- You choose what it does: a chat, a chess game, a shopping list, an
  IoT simulation… Slightly more than the course examples, no need to
  shoot for the moon.
- The client has a **REPL**; the server accepts **several clients at
  the same time** (no idea where that makes sense? ask us).
- Packaged with **Docker**, published on GitHub Container Registry.

## Demo 2: weather station, with UDP

- Sensors **multicast** their measures, fire and forget; a client asks
  the station in **unicast**.

::: {style="font-size: 0.7em"}
```{.text filename="Thermometer" code-line-numbers="false"}
Emitter of type thermometer started (127.0.0.1:9876).
Multicasting measure : 1.0 to 239.0.0.1:9876 on interface en0
Multicasting measure : 38.0 to 239.0.0.1:9876 on interface en0
```

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{.text filename="Weather station" code-line-numbers="false"}
Multicast receiver started (127.0.0.1:9876)
Unicast receiver started (127.0.0.1:1234)
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{.text filename="Client" code-line-numbers="false"}
> 3
List all measures (1) or only the average? (2)
> 2
Received average: 1003.83
```
:::
::::
:::

## Groups and idea

- **Two to three** students. No partner? We assign you one.
- Open a **GitHub Discussion**, category *Show and tell*, with your
  group and your idea, **before the next course**.
- We may ask you to change the scope if it is too small or too large.

## Grading

- 25 criteria, each **0**, **0.1** or **0.2**; grade = points + 1, **6
  maximum**.

::: {style="font-size: 0.8em"}
| Category | Criteria | Weight |
|----------|---------:|-------:|
| Docker and GitHub Container Registry | 4 | 16% |
| Application protocol | 8 | 32% |
| Network programming | 6 | 24% |
| Network concurrency | 2 | 8% |
| Tests | 1 | 4% |
| Presentation | 4 | 16% |
:::

- The full grid is on the [practical work page](../practical-work/pw2.qmd).

## Rules

- Everyone contributes, and everyone can explain the whole project.
- Only the **Java classes of the course** for the network part.
- PW1's good practices continue, and it **builds from a fresh clone**.
- State your sources, AI included. Copying another group: grade **1**.
- Each rule broken costs up to **1 point**.

## Submission and presentations

- Update your Discussion with the **repository link and the commit
  hash**. Each day late costs **1 point**.

::: {style="font-size: 0.85em"}
| | Due | Presentations |
|---|---|---|
| DAI-TIC-A | Tuesday 01.12, 23:59 | Wednesday 02.12 |
| DAI-TIC-C | Monday 30.11, 23:59 | Tuesday 01.12 |
:::

- **8 minutes** per group: the application running, with an error
  case, and the protocol and its choices.

## Tips

- **Keep it simple**: a small protocol, well specified, with its errors
  handled, beats an ambitious one that half works.
- Test the protocol logic **without the network**: a method takes a
  message and returns the answer.
- GitHub Container Registry packages start **private**: make yours
  public.
